command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /job/out
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv,noheader > /job/out/gpu.csv
/isaac-sim/python.sh - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tee /job/out/isaac_smoke.log
from isaacsim import SimulationApp
app = SimulationApp({'headless': True})
app.update()
print('ATEAM_ISAAC_SIM_6_SMOKE_OK')
app.close()
PY
test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0
printf 'image=nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-sim:6.0.0\nstatus=passed\n' > /job/out/manifest.txt
name: ateam-isaac6-smoke
